item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: Folia Files 1.3
item.description:
Finder Alternative for Mac File Management

Folia Files is a native macOS file manager written in Swift. It is compatible with macOS 14 and later, works with both Apple silicon and Intel Macs, and offers a Simplified Chinese interface. It supports a dual-pane and freely draggable multi-pane layout, allowing folders, terminals, and function modules to be placed side by side. Commonly used operating environments can be saved through tabs, scenes, and workspaces. The software offers nine file views and supports independent configuration of folder sorting, grouping, and display modes. It also allows for customization of themes, window transparency, folder icons, and backgrounds. The search function not only covers file names but also allows you to search document text, text in screenshots, and image content. Combined with a locally running natural language assistant, it enables you to complete searches and file organization. Cloud storage, NAS, and remote servers can be accessed centrally. Combined with folder synchronization, scheduled backups, batch renaming, duplicate file detection, PDF processing, and automatic organization rules, it covers daily data management needs. The screen edge drawer, clipboard history, open and save dialog assistants, and disk space analysis further expand the range of available actions.

item.title: Watchflows 1.63.1
item.description:
macOS Intelligent AI No-Code Automated Workflow

Watchflows is a visual automation tool for macOS 14 Sonoma and later that links file organization, screenshot naming, PDF summarization, and app actions into no-code workflows. Users simply describe tasks in natural language, and the built-in AI generates nodes on the canvas, connects steps, and explains each part. Afterward, users can still manually drag and drop to adjust, add branches, or switch AI services. The software offers eighty nodes across ten categories, supporting task triggering through events such as folder changes, keyboard shortcuts, clipboard actions, scheduled tasks, and app launches. It also integrates with Mac applications like Notes, Reminders, Calendar, Mail, and Shortcuts. Conditional statements, loops, text templates, HTTP requests, and workflow calls can be used to build more complex processing logic, and run logs make it easy to check execution status. Workflows, run logs, and history are stored locally, and keys are stored in the macOS Keychain. AI can choose native solutions such as Apple Intelligence and Ollama, or connect to external services such as Claude and ChatGPT.

item.title: Snaggy 1.7
item.description:
Cross-browser bookmarking tool for macOS

Snaggy is a native bookmark management and read-later tool for macOS. It allows you to save the current web page from different browsers using a unified shortcut key, consolidating scattered links into a single library. The default shortcut key is ⌘D. It only takes over the bookmarking operation when the browser is in the foreground, and you can also change it yourself. The software supports importing browser bookmarks, pinned tabs, and HTML bookmark files, preserving the original folder structure for easy migration of existing favorites. On eligible Macs, it uses Apple's on-device model to automatically create folders and organize links; when the requirements are not met, it categorizes them by website. The built-in reader supports blocking ads and trackers, offers a reading mode for articles, automatically marks articles as read upon reaching the end, and can open web pages in the browser used when the link was saved. Users can search their favorites from the menu bar and use local MCP services to enable AI tools like Claude, Codex, and Cursor to search for and save links. The database is stored locally, and no account creation is required. You can choose to use your personal iCloud to sync across multiple Macs, and it supports exporting to JSON, CSV, and HTML.

item.title: Putback 1.3.4
item.description:
macOS Window Layout Restoration

Putback is a macOS window management tool focused on layout memory and window restoration, ideal for users who frequently connect external monitors, switch desks, or work with multiple screens. It automatically records the position, size, and associated display of windows during daily operations, and saves layouts for different display combinations separately; When the MacBook is reconnected to the monitor, windows can automatically return to their original positions, reducing the need for repeated dragging and adjustments. The software supports saving the work environment as a named scene. You can quickly switch between programming, meeting, or focused work layouts using dedicated hotkeys. You can also pre-arrange application window areas in Scene Studio, and when applying a scene, the relevant programs will automatically launch and be arranged, while the scene wallpaper is switched. Users can also set application rules, undo the last restore, and view the results of window adjustments through the action history with reasons. Putback supports Shortcuts integration, allowing scenes to be triggered according to schedule or at the start of a video call, with layout data stored locally.

item.title: Lyrimuse 1.13.0
item.description:
Elegant macOS desktop lyrics tool

Lyrimuse is an open-source desktop lyrics app for macOS. It resides in the menu bar and highlights lyrics word by word as songs play. It displays content via floating desktop widgets, Dynamic Island-style capsules, the menu bar, the Touch Bar, or a separate lyrics window. It supports 20 music players, including Apple Music, Spotify, QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music, Kugou, Soda Music, and Luxue Music. It can also connect to YouTube Music and the web version of Spotify in your browser, automatically scoring and selecting matching results from 15 lyric sources. The software provides lyric translations, Cantonese romanization, Japanese kana, and romanizations in multiple languages. It supports simplified-to-traditional Chinese conversion, local lyric import, song-by-song time correction, and offline display of cached lyrics. Users can customize fonts, colors, backgrounds, and layouts, hide lyrics when taking screenshots, recording screens, and sharing screens, and send lyrics to LAN devices or use them as an OBS transparent browser source.

item.title: DynamicNotch 1.6.4
item.description:
macOS Open Source Dynamic Island Enhancement Tool

DynamicNotch is a native macOS Dynamic Island and notch interaction tool that transforms the notch area at the top of the MacBook screen into a dynamic interface for displaying live activities, system status, and quick interactions. It supports controls for currently playing media, album covers, audio visualizations, and customization of the playback progress bar color. It can also display download progress, AirDrop, timers, screen recording indicators, Focus mode, and Personal Hotspot status. Additionally, it provides media and Live Activity interfaces on the lock screen. The software can display temporary status notifications for events such as charging, low battery, full battery, Bluetooth connection, Wi-Fi, and VPN, allowing users to stay informed about device changes in real time. In terms of interaction, it supports mouse dragging, trackpad swiping, vertical swiping to collapse and restore, and horizontal scrolling to close. Combined with adaptive rounded corners, blur effects, and physics-based spring animations, it presents stretching, compression, and elastic deformation. For MacBooks, iMacs, Mac minis, or external displays without a physical notch, the software can automatically adopt a floating capsule form. The project is open-source under the GPL v3 license and is suitable for users who want to view system updates in one place and enhance their desktop interaction experience.

item.title: ZevLink 4.0.3
item.description:
Cross-device collaboration between Android and Mac

ZevLink is a local-first cross-device collaboration tool that connects Android phones and Macs. It synchronizes information over the same Wi-Fi network, LAN, or mobile hotspot, without requiring account registration or relying on cloud-based transfers. The software supports two-way synchronization of clipboard text, as well as sending clipboard images from Mac to Android, making it easy to continue processing content between your phone and computer. With AirPlay, users can mirror their Android screen to a Mac and stream audio from their phone to a Mac or a selected AirPlay receiver. Android notifications can be displayed as native macOS notifications, and users can also answer, decline, mute, and end incoming calls on their Mac, as well as check their phone's battery level via the menu bar. For first-time use, you can scan the QR code on the Mac to complete pairing. Manual pairing is also supported. Bonjour/mDNS is responsible for device discovery and reconnection after network switching. The software does not collect analytical data. Pairing tokens are used to verify communication requests, but the clipboard and control traffic use local HTTP and do not provide end-to-end encryption. It is suitable for use on trusted networks.

item.title: Motrix 2.4.3
item.description:
Multi-Protocol Resource Download Tool

Motrix for Mac is an all-around download tool. Support HTTP download, FTP download, BT download, magnetic link download, Baidu net disk resource download. Motrix also uses "Aria 2" as the core, so the download speed, multi-threading and other capabilities are almost the same as other download tools.

item.title: WallpaperMachine 1.13.0
item.description:
Native Dynamic Wallpaper Tool for macOS

WallpaperMachine is a native live wallpaper app for Macs with Apple silicon. It can run Wallpaper Engine's scene wallpapers, video wallpapers, and web wallpapers on macOS 15 Sequoia and later versions. The app features built-in browsing and downloading from the Steam Workshop, allowing you to browse a vast amount of content without logging in. To download, you need a Steam account with Wallpaper Engine. For scene wallpapers, you also need to purchase the shared resources separately during installation. The interface is divided into three tabs: Discover, Installed, and Settings. After selecting a wallpaper, press Play to apply it to the desktop. Each monitor can have its wallpaper set independently or mirrored from another monitor, and zoom, frame rate, and volume can be configured separately. After enabling audio response, wallpapers designed for sound will move in sync with the content currently playing on the Mac. Media integration allows wallpapers with music displays to show the song that is currently playing. When running on battery power, you can choose to keep running, reduce the load according to the custom rendering scale and frame rate, or pause directly. Videos and scene wallpapers can also be used experimentally for lock screen animations.

item.title: OnlySwitch release_3.7.0
item.description:
Menu Bar System Switches Collection

OnlySwitch is a powerful macOS menu bar application that provides a series of switches designed to simplify the user's daily workflow, such as hiding desktop icons, switching dark mode, and hiding the grooves of the new MacBook Pro. The user can easily control these functions in the status bar, and the displayed switches and shortcuts can be customized as needed. Since version 1. As of 7, users can import custom shortcuts into OnlySwitch and support keyboard shortcuts from version 2.0. The app also supports Apple widgets, which allow users to place relevant switches and buttons on their desktops or notification centers for quick and easy access. OnlySwitch supports switching between various macOS browsers, keeping users' browsing history and allowing users to add or remove features based on their needs. The software comes with a 30-day free trial and can be installed via Homebrew or downloaded manually. OnlySwitch is a powerful menu bar app designed to streamline users' daily workflows, such as hiding desktop icons, switching between dark modes, and hiding the bangs of the new MacBook Pro.

item.title: WaifuX 38.0.158
item.description:
Open-source ACG anime live wallpaper software

WaifuX is an open-source, all-in-one ACG app for macOS that brings together static wallpapers, live wallpapers, and anime videos, covering the entire user experience from browsing and filtering to setting wallpapers as your desktop with a single click. Static wallpapers support switching between two sources, Wallhaven and 4K Wall, covering all resolutions from 4K to 8K. Dynamic wallpapers connect to sources like MotionBGs to bring your desktop to life. Anime videos feature a built-in multi-source parsing engine, allowing you to watch and follow your favorite series all within the same app. Smart search supports multi-dimensional filtering by keywords, tags, categories, colors, and resolutions. The collection system allows you to build your personal ACG resource library and set different wallpapers for each display. Importing local folders allows for centralized management of personal collections. The experimental Wallpaper Engine rendering pipeline can render scenes and Web-type live wallpapers and only supports Apple Silicon. The app requires macOS 14 or later, is compatible with Apple Silicon and Intel, offers interfaces in Simplified Chinese, English, and Japanese, and can be installed via the official website, GitHub Releases, or Homebrew. It is suitable for anime fans to change wallpapers and follow anime series on a daily basis.

item.title: UTM 5.0.9
item.description:
macOS Open Source Free Virtual Machine

UTM is a powerful virtualization software that leverages the popular QEMU system emulator to securely run various operating systems in a sandboxed environment, protecting user data from viruses and malware. It is specifically designed for macOS Big Sur and later versions, taking full advantage of Apple's latest technologies. By combining powerful features with a user-friendly experience, UTM is the ideal choice for Mac users to virtualize and emulate operating systems. Whether for development, testing, or simply experiencing an operating system, UTM can meet users' needs. Run ARM64 operating systems: UTM supports fully virtualized operation of operating systems such as Windows 10 ARM and Ubuntu ARM on Apple Silicon Macs at near-native speeds. Intel/AMD operating system emulation: Allows Windows 7, Windows XP, Ubuntu, and other operating systems to run in emulation mode with limited performance on Apple Silicon Macs, while full virtualization is possible on Intel Macs.

item.title: CaskHub 0.10.0
item.description:
Homebrew Application Update Management

CaskHub is a native macOS graphical application management tool for Homebrew Cask, featuring a SwiftUI interface that centralizes the browsing, searching, installation, updating, and uninstallation of thousands of Mac applications into a single window. The software provides categorized navigation, curated recommendations, popular lists, and lists of recently added applications. It allows for instant searches by name, identifier, and description, and displays the original application icon, download size, number of installs, version, and official website information. Application management directly invokes the native brew, can recognize Cask installed via the command line, and can also incorporate applications installed via DMG or other stores into Homebrew management, while retaining the original application location. The installation process supports real-time progress and download cancellation. Smart update detection skips apps that update themselves, reducing invalid notifications caused by differences in version suffixes. The interface supports grid and list views, flexible sorting, and light and dark themes, and is available in Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. Homebrew does not need to be pre-installed to browse the app directory. However, Homebrew is required to install, update, or uninstall apps. If it is missing, you can configure it by following the instructions.

item.title: Sniffnet 1.6.0
item.description:
Open Source Network Traffic Monitoring

Sniffnet is a network traffic monitoring tool for macOS that helps users easily view ongoing internet communications. It is suitable for people who want to know which hosts their devices are connecting to, which services they are using, and whether there is any abnormal traffic. It balances professional capabilities with an easy-to-use experience, offering features such as real-time statistics, traffic intensity charts, connection searches, and in-depth inspections, making network analysis more than just a tool for technical experts. Sniffnet supports selecting network adapters, setting filter conditions, importing and exporting PCAP packet capture reports, and can identify information such as local network connections, remote host geographical locations, domain names, and ASNs. It can also display the programs generating traffic and various upper-layer protocols. The software adopts a security-first design approach, focusing on data privacy and system integrity. It offers a multilingual interface and a clear user manual, making it easy for users from different backgrounds to get started quickly and continuously monitor network status. Sniffnet is a lightweight and professional network traffic monitoring tool suitable for viewing internet connection details, analyzing communication targets, tracking real-time traffic changes, and transforming complex network information into understandable data through a clear interface.

item.title: Prism 11 11.2.0
item.description:
Professional Scientific Research Data Processing Tool

GraphPad Prism is a data analysis and graphing software for scientific research, integrating statistical analysis, curve fitting, data organization, and scientific graphing. It is suitable for use in life sciences, medicine, pharmacology, and other fields. It organizes inputs in a tabular structure suitable for experimental data, helping users to enter data more accurately and quickly select the appropriate analysis method, while providing clear statistical explanations and operational guidelines to lower the threshold for understanding complex statistical processes. The software supports a variety of tasks, including common t-tests, analysis of variance, regression, nonlinear fitting, survival analysis, and principal component analysis. It can also automatically generate publication-quality charts, update results and graphs in real time, and facilitate team sharing, viewing, and discussion of projects through cloud collaboration features. For researchers who need to efficiently process experimental data, generate standardized charts, and maintain traceability of their analyses, Prism offers a complete workflow from raw data to the presentation of results. GraphPad Prism is a data analysis and graphing tool for scientific research. It builds a complete workflow around experimental data organization, statistical testing, curve fitting, result presentation, and team collaboration. It is suitable for both quickly completing routine analyses and handling more complex scientific data scenarios.

item.title: Capture 3.6
item.description:
Note-taking and idea-gathering tool for macOS

Quick Notes – Capture is a quick note-taking and idea-gathering tool for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision, and Apple Watch, with a core experience centered around low-friction input, instant organization, and cross-app flow. It is suitable for first capturing spontaneous ideas, to-do lists, web links, image attachments, voice content, and reminders, and then exporting them as needed to commonly used tools such as Obsidian, Things, Todoist, iA Writer, Craft, OmniFocus, Fantastical, Apple Calendar, Reminders, etc. The software supports iCloud syncing, desktop and lock screen widgets, share extensions, Siri and Shortcuts, automatic recognition of dates and URLs, document scanning, list sorting, merging and splitting of records, and other features. It can serve both as a daily outlet for clearing your mind and as a hub between different productivity systems. Its interface emphasizes simplicity and stability, avoiding distractions caused by complex workflows, allowing users to quickly save ideas when inspiration strikes and then process, archive, or execute them at the appropriate time.

item.title: Verso 1.0.69
item.description:
Native Lightweight Word Processor

Verso Writer is a native lightweight word processor for macOS that emphasizes fast startup, focused writing, and reliable document compatibility. It opens and saves DOCX, Markdown, RTF, ODT, TXT and other common formats for collaboration between Microsoft Word, Google Docs, LibreOffice, GitHub and other workflows. The software provides compact toolbars, elegant page layout, focus mode, paperless mode, a variety of page appearance, table of contents, annotations, revisions, footnotes, header and footer, tables, images, find replacements and word count and other writing and typesetting capabilities. Markdown files can be visually edited and preserved in rich text, and code blocks support syntax highlighting; BibTeX and CSL JSON reference management can generate references in multiple formats. The app is built with SwiftUI and AppKit. It does not rely on Electron, web view or cloud account. The interface supports multiple languages. It is suitable for Mac writers who need low burden, privacy-friendly, and full-featured.

item.title: FileBo 1.3.1
item.description:
macOS File Quick Access Tool

FileBo is a quick access tool for recent files that resides in the macOS menu bar, and it pops up a simple window showing the files and folders you recently used, changed, saved, or downloaded, like a smart drawer that fills in automatically, solving everyday problems that files can't find immediately after saving or downloading. Finder excels at a lot of things, but remembering exactly where that file went five minutes ago is not always its strong point, FileBo puts recent files, folders, apps, and connected drives all at the touch of a button, even inside a full-screen app, so you can instantly get back to the document, picture, zip, or project you were working on. It's more focused and practical than Finder's built-in view of recent projects, designed to quickly retrieve what you're working on, and you can decide where you want to track, add unwanted files or folders to your ignore list, and eliminate things you never want to see.

item.title: StepGrab 1.7.0
item.description:
Creating Step-by-Step Tutorials for macOS

StepGrab is a workflow recording and step-by-step tutorial generation tool that resides in the macOS menu bar. It automatically recognizes interactions as users click through workflows, captures screenshots for each click, numbers the steps, and generates coherent and accurate operating instructions, eliminating the repetitive work of taking screenshots one by one and manually writing documentation. It accurately captures menus, drop-down lists, pop-up windows, system selectors, double-clicks, keyboard shortcuts, and scroll indicators, and arranges the visuals with rounded corners and shadows that closely resemble native Mac windows. The app supports exporting the results as a looping GIF, an animated PDF, or an HD MP4. You can also adjust the color scheme, numbering style, layout, PDF quality, light or dark appearance, and add a brand logo. On-device AI can help generate more natural step-by-step instructions, while text recognition and element localization can improve the accuracy of menu and pop-up descriptions. The entire screen processing procedure is completed locally on the Mac. There is no need to upload the recorded content to the cloud, and you can start using it without an account.

item.title: Zinnia 1.50
item.description:
macOS Digital Note-Taking, Journaling, and Schedule Management

Zinnia is a creative app for digital journaling, planning, and note-taking. It combines diary writing, schedule planning, and visual layout, making it ideal for those who enjoy integrating handwriting, typing, images, and templates. It features a comprehensive built-in Studio asset library that includes diary pages, schedules, trackers, stickers, washi tape, frames, and templates. The library is continuously updated with new content to help users quickly create pages with their own personal style. The app supports calendar syncing, habit management, goal breakdown, and time management. It also offers features such as mood tracking, gratitude journaling, and self-care planning, helping users organize their lives more effectively. It retains a writing experience similar to that of pen and paper, supporting the Apple Pencil, freehand drawing, graphic drawing, layer adjustment, cropping and rotation, and link navigation. It can also import PDFs, photos, and annotations, making it convenient for taking study notes, organizing projects, or creating collages. Zinnia is an app that combines digital journaling, schedule management, and creative note-taking. It is ideal for recording life events, planning time, organizing inspirations, and creating personalized pages. You can both handwrite and type text, and you can also use a wide range of templates and materials to quickly complete layouts.

item.title: LitPads SoundBoard 1.9.11
item.description:
Mac Live Audio Routing Tool

LitPads is a custom soundboard app for musicians, DJs, podcasters, live streamers, theater and live event voice controls, and content creators that creates multiple soundboards on Mac, iPhone, and iPad, imports your own audio files, and triggers playback with ultra-low latency. It supports one-time triggering, looping, switching, press-and-hold playback and other modes. Each Pad can independently adjust the volume, audio, fade, EQ, tone change, clip range and reverb, and provide multi-voice playback. It is suitable for live performances, program crossovers, stage prompts, church and theater cue, TikTok/Reels material production, and live workflows such as OBS, Twitch, YouTube Live, Discord, and Zoom. The Mac side can be used with virtual audio drivers for audio routing. Functions such as MIDI control, track serialization, automatic depression, global fade-out, cue list, and iCloud synchronization make complex performance processes easier to manage.

item.title: NiBoard 12.0.1
item.description:
Mac Lightweight Canvas Whiteboard Notes

NiBoard is a simple whiteboard and handwriting note-taking tool for macOS, iPad, and iPhone, suitable for classroom presentations, sketching ideas, visual thinking, project planning, and impromptu presentations. It offers common tools such as an infinite canvas, Apple Pencil support, pens and highlighters, line arrows, shapes, and text, allowing users to quickly jot down ideas and create clear diagrams. The app supports creating multiple artboards and renaming, copying, pinning, and searching them, making it easy to manage courses, drafts, ideas, and plans separately. Lines, arrows, and shapes can be selected and then moved, resized, recolored, and their strokes adjusted. Closed shapes can also be filled with color. Combined with blank, grid, dot matrix, and ruled canvas styles, they are better suited for organizing notes, making teaching annotations, and creating structured diagrams. Auto-save, undo/redo, eraser, zoom, dark mode, and PNG and PDF export features make daily writing, sharing, and saving more convenient. NiBoard is a lightweight and easy-to-use digital whiteboard and visual note-taking app designed for quick drawing, clear expression, and multi-canvas management. It is suitable for students, teachers, creators, and users who need to organize their thoughts visually.

item.title: Highlight Studio 1.0.44
item.description:
Mac Screen Recording and Editing Tool

Highlight Studio is a screen recording and video editing tool for Mac. It supports recording the screen, windows, applications, and webcam footage, and can simultaneously capture system audio and microphone sound. It is suitable for creating presentations, tutorials, product demonstrations, and high-quality screencasts. It features built-in multi-track timeline editing for trimming, splitting, speed adjustment, and freeze-frame processing. It also offers effects such as smart zoom, cursor tracking, click highlighting, and mouse smoothing to make operation demonstrations clearer. The app also features automatic subtitle transcription, supports multiple languages and word-by-word timestamps, making it easy to quickly generate shareable video content. Highlight Studio is a screen recording and video editing app designed for Mac. It combines screen recording, webcam overlay, audio capture, AI transcription, and precise editing, making it ideal for creating software demos, course videos, product introductions, and short videos for social media platforms. Multi-scenario recording: Supports recording the entire screen, a single window, or a specific application, and can also record iPhone and iPad screens via USB, meeting the material collection needs of different devices and presentation scenarios.

item.title: UlyssesMac 42.2
item.description:
Mac Focused Writing Tool Markdown Editor

Ulysses is a one-stop writing, note-taking, and document management tool for Mac, iPhone, and iPad users for novelists, bloggers, students, researchers, and others who have been working on text content for a long time. Focused editing based on Markdown markup separates content creation from final typography, allowing users to focus on writing and editing. All your articles, journals, study notes, and large projects are centralized in a unified library, organized by groups, projects, keywords, and filters, and automatically saved and synced across Apple devices. The software built-in supports grammar and style checking in more than 20 languages, and can give suggestions for modification for punctuation, case, semantics, redundancy, and expression. At the same time, it provides practical capabilities such as word count targets, writing history, quick opening, backlinks, catalogs, mathematical equations, and project templates.

item.title: Highland Pro 3.4.1
item.description:
Professional Film and Television Script Writing

Highland Pro is a professional writing app created by renowned screenwriter and novelist John August, designed for film and television writers, novelists, and all users who need to focus on creating. It uses a clean, clean interface and innovative writing tools to help users focus entirely on story content rather than cumbersome formatting. Highland Pro fully supports Mac, iPad, and iPhone, allowing users to create scripts, screenplays, and novels on the go. The new Lookup feature lets you quickly query definitions, rhymes, or world facts directly in drafts without switching apps; The Shelf lets users store snippets, notes, and creative ideas securely, avoiding the accidental deletion of important conversations. Title Page Builder quickly generates professional title pages that meet industry standards, and Custom Pages supports adding custom pages such as a foreword, cast, or production breakdown. The Overview view provides an overview of the work, highlighting key elements such as characters, scenes, and more; Grammar Highlight enhances the quality of writing by analyzing nouns, verbs, adjectives, and adverbs.

item.title: Mouse Jiggler 3.5.2
item.description:
Mac Mouse Movement Simulation Tool

Mouse Jiggler – Mouse Mover is a lightweight utility designed for Mac that meets a variety of interaction needs by generating subtle, natural mouse cursor movements. It places special emphasis on accessibility design, helping users with low vision to use the moving cursor as a visual anchor, easily locate the pointer, and reduce eye strain. Provides automatic movement for users with limited motor control, such as those with hand tremors, to prevent them from having to constantly shake the mouse manually to keep the pointer responsive. At the same time, it continuously provides visual feedback for users requiring cognitive assistance, confirming that the system interface is actively responsive and not frozen. Mouse Jiggler – Mouse Mover supports the simulation of real mouse input and is compatible with various input devices such as mice, trackpads, and trackballs. It keeps your Mac active in remote desktop, long-duration download, monitoring dashboard, or video conferencing scenarios, preventing the screen from going to sleep or changing to an inactive state. It offers flexible movement options, including various movement styles, silent mode, and an optional auto-click feature, allowing users to customize behavior based on their actual needs.

item.title: Kompressor 1.3.5
item.description:
Quick Image Format Conversion Tool

Kompressor is a convenient image conversion tool that supports conversion between over 50 input formats and 20 output formats, including JPEG, HEIC, AVIF, WebP, PNG, and more. Users can easily complete the conversion by simply dragging and dropping files. The app also offers sound effects, haptic feedback, and smooth animations, adding to the enjoyment of use. At the same time, Kompressor allows users to quickly remove EXIF and other metadata from images, such as location information and device model, to ensure privacy. The app optimizes performance and simplicity, supports batch conversion of multiple images, and automatically supports new input image formats after each macOS update. Kompressor operates completely offline, without requiring an internet connection. It is also designed with a focus on privacy and does not include any analytics or tracking features. This app was created by independent developer Lucas and is continuously updated to ensure its long-term stable operation. If users have any feedback or need assistance, they can contact the developer directly via email.

item.title: Session 2.13.49
item.description:
Mac Pomodoro Focus Timer

Session – The Pomodoro Focus Timer is a productivity tool for Mac, iPhone, and iPad that helps users enter a stable state of focus based on the Pomodoro Technique and time blocking. By setting focus periods and break periods, it reduces distractions during studying, writing, coding, and daily work, and reminds you to stop, record, and reflect at the end of each phase. On Mac, it supports blocking distracting websites and apps, muting Slack, and automatically enabling Do Not Disturb mode. It can also use AppleScript and Shortcuts to integrate the focus process into system-level automation. The app also provides categories, intentions, notes, statistical analysis, and progress reviews, making it easy for you to view your daily time allocation, task duration, and focus patterns. It also syncs conversations to Apple Calendar, making it suitable for long-term use by people who need to engage in deep work, develop habits, and practice self-management. Session – Pomodoro Focus Timer is a productivity tool that integrates focus timing, distraction blocking, automated linkage, and progress review. It is suitable for users who need to establish a consistent work rhythm on Mac, iPhone, and iPad.

item.title: PasteNow 2.39
item.description:
Lightweight clipboard management tool for macOS

PasteNow is a Mac clipboard management tool that supports data synchronization across multiple devices and the reuse of historical data. It can intelligently categorize clipboard content based on rules and offers various list styles, such as grid views and simple lists, to display the content. Users can preview text, links, and images, and can also add sensitive apps to the exclusion list to protect their privacy. PasteNow relies on iCloud to achieve cloud-based data synchronization, ensuring that clipboard history can be shared across different devices. It also supports full keyboard operation and custom hotkeys to improve operational efficiency. Users can also collect and organize clipboard content using the drag-and-drop feature and selectively save data by setting exclusion rules, providing convenient preview and editing functions. PasteNow is a brand-new clipboard management tool that supports data synchronization across multiple devices, allowing users to easily reuse clipboard history data and categorize history content using rules. Content Preview: Preview clipboard text, links, and image content, with support for HEX color display. Rich views: Clipboard content can be displayed in a variety of styles, including grid view, simple list, and rich list.

item.title: Floodtide 1.6.0
item.description:
App updater for macOS

Floodtide is an app updater for macOS that reads the latest version information from each app's own Sparkle update feed and from the Homebrew catalog, then scans supported apps and updates them in bulk. It needs no hand-maintained app database and no Homebrew installation, and it checks official downloads and checksums published by developers. Apps whose update source can't be verified are listed clearly rather than guessed at. It offers one-click Update All, automatic backup before updating, undo of recent updates within seven days, and checks of code signature, Gatekeeper results and developer team before installing. It supports macOS 13 or later on Intel and Apple Silicon, keeps its app list on your Mac, and needs no account or special permissions.

item.title: Multitouch 2.0.8

macOS trackpad gesture control enhancement

Multitouch is a powerful gesture engine designed to easily add gestures to macOS, with support for a well-designed trackpad and magic mouse gestures, and a plethora of options for browsers, keyboard shortcuts, and click actions. The software has built-in best-in-class window management features, including Rectangle's keyboard shortcuts, menu items, and drag-and-drop alignment areas. In addition, users can convert a key to a superkey, click with a key, remap a button, or create a shortcut to execute a script. Multitouch supports the use of any trackpad or magic mouse on macOS 10.15 and above, and each license can be activated simultaneously on up to three devices. Multitouch is a powerful gesture engine designed to easily add multi-touch gestures to macOS with a well-designed trackpad and Magic Mouse gestures. The software provides rich operation options, including browser operations, keystrokes, mouse clicks, etc., to help users achieve efficient workflows.

item.title: Almighty 2.13.7
item.description:
Quick-action enhancement tool for macOS

Almighty is an app with more than 50 Mac tweaks to improve your experience. It lets you easily customize settings such as hiding desktop icons, masking keyboard input, and showing the cursor and keystroke visualization. It manages system settings like clearing the clipboard, converting text to plain text, scheduled shutdown and dark mode, offers deep Dock and Xcode customization (Dock appearance, build times, disabling auto-restore), and tunes Finder settings such as showing or hiding files and adding a Quit option. Everything is reachable from the menu bar. It is written entirely in Swift, is native to the Mac and collects no data.
